# API icon reference

The three glyphs in api-icons.json were extracted from the publicly rendered Creator Hub API reference pages supplied for this visual comparison. Artwork belongs to Roblox Corporation. The source URL is retained per glyph. Geometry and colors are preserved; redundant clipping wrappers and generated DOM IDs are omitted. Library-specific member categories reuse the nearest documented family. Unverified categories deliberately render no glyph.

These files are a visual-preview specimen. Redistribution rights for the inline frontend artwork have not been independently established by the Creator Docs repository license; review before merging or distributing this renderer. No account data, full HTML, frontend scripts or fonts are included.
